column2: (1) All data are current as of the "Date" shown.
(2) All distances are calculated from the gully mouth.
(3) Nickpoint data--the "Depth"; "Width"; "Volume"; & "Erosion" are for the scour hole that is created downstream from the gully mouth prior to the headcut migrating upstream.

(4) Mouth to Ridge Line data--"Drainage Area" & "Maximum Distance" are from the gully mouth to the ridge line; the "Headcut Distance" is the current location of the headcut from the gully mouth; and the "Accumulative Volume & Erosion" are the accumulative section totals for the gully.

(5) Partition data--Each section number's "Drainage Area"; "Distance"; and "Width" is at the downstream end while its depth is equal to the nickpoint's; the "Volume" and "Erosion" are calculated in the interval between the downstream and upstream ends.
